openai-provisioned-reserve-production.title: Always-on hourly PTUs: use a reservation for production
openai-provisioned-reserve-production.body: This deployment is billed hourly for the full month. Microsoft recommends hourly billing only for short-term use such as benchmarking, and a 1-month or 1-year reservation is cheaper for steady production capacity.

citation.source: Provisioned throughput billing and cost management
citation.quote: Hourly billing isn't appropriate for deployments in production (use reservations instead).

openai-provisioned-deploy-first.title: Create the deployment before buying the reservation
openai-provisioned-deploy-first.body: Capacity changes often by region and model, so a reservation bought first can cover PTUs you are then unable to deploy. Deploy first, then buy the reservation to match.

citation.source: Provisioned throughput billing and cost management
citation.quote: always create deployments first, then purchase the Azure Reservation to cover the PTUs you've deployed.
